title: Completed offboarding command receipt
description: The receipt the organization offboarding request mutation returns. Its four top-level keys are the same merged receipt envelope the entitlement receipt carries; only the response vocabulary differs, and command-receipt.json cannot describe these because its enum is closed against widening.

status.description: A receipt reaches the customer only once its command has completed.

responseCode.description: One code per mutation, and the route pins the exact code it expects. UNSUPPORTED_SERVER_RESPONSE is the consumer's representation of a value it does not recognize; the backend never emits it.

responsePayload.description: The owning routine's own result. Its interior belongs to that routine's contract rather than to this envelope, so it is not restated here.
